patch_description: Add a multi-start strategy: run the annealed hill-climb from several deterministic seeds (triangular lattice, hexagonal-like layout, and random barycentric samples), splitting the iteration budget across starts, then fine-polish the best configuration. Prior generations showed multi-start escapes local optima effectively at low cost. Each start uses its own deterministically seeded RNG for reproducibility. All starts are precomputed at module load and cached, so `heilbronn_triangle11()` returns instantly.
